text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's Tamamo Cross! Tamamo Cross wins!
The
senior racer holds her ground and
bests Oguri
Cap!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It feels like only yesterday that she won
the
Takarazuka Kinen, and today she has
dominated
the autumn Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeeeah!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I did it! Trainer, I DID IT!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Damn straight! I'm number one! I was in
it to win
it, and I did! Wooooo!
choice_data_list: That was a fantastic run, Tamamo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Until now, Tamamo Cross has been
running with
her family in mind. But
today, she burns hotter
than ever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A pure athlete through and through, she
burned white-hot. She pooled all her
attention and
energy into this race, and
it shows.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Littl...
text_block_list.text: Dad, Tama did it! She won!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text:
She sure did...
But winnin' or losin' isn't important
to me no more... As long as
she gets the fans all hyped up 'n makes
it to the finish line in one piece, that's
plenty for me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text:
Tama's turned this family around... She
could stop
now 'n my heart'd never stop
swellin' with pride...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Littl...
text_block_list.text:
Tama's so amazin'! I wanna run just like
her one
day!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Well done, Tama. I may have lost, but
today,
for the first time...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I used everything I had in a race.
And it's
because
I raced with you, Tama.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The feelin's mutual. I used up all my
energy for
the first time today.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And the box lunch I ate before today's
race was
extra tasty. Maybe that played
a part too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But we're on the same page here, right?
Today
was just our first battle. This isn't
over yet. Not by
a long shot.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Our next race will be the Arima Kinen. That's gonna be the real showdown. Where the score gets settled once and for all...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I know. But... that won't be enough for
me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep running with you, Tama.
On and
on. So I'll be waiting for you at
the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Da heck?! You wanna run three G1 races
in a
row? Oguri, you're still a classic-year
runner...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'll be fine, don't worry. ...I am Oguri Cap, you know.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No matter the distance, track type or
schedule, there's no race I can't handle.
As long as I keep
dreaming, I can keep
running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That night...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what should we do next?
There's the
Japan Cup, or we could...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh, uh, right. But the Japan Cup's...
choice_data_list: Let's make the Arima Kinen our goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross's performance today was
strong.
Ideally we'd just maintain this
momentum, but the
problem is...
choice_data_list: We'll see how things go before mak...
We'll see how things go before mak...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I can... still get stronger.
Oguri
helped me
realize that.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm nowhere near perfect, but I still won
today. By
the time the Arima Kinen rolls
'round, I'll be at my
peak... probably.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And when I am, I won't be losin' to
nobody! I'll be
freakin' unstoppable!
...Probably!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But... if anyone was able to overtake me
at that
point... at my very best...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It'd have to be you-know-who... when she's at her very best.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That's just how amazin' she is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though Tamamo Cross's strength came out on
top this time, Oguri Cap wasn't
far behind... We'll have to wait until the
Arima Kinen to see how their legendary
battle will play out.
